items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided transcript; the mention of Ed Straughan is made solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: I had another partner play my guitar.
Ed Straughan is a preacher. He lived near now. He had a church he played. He got off. Come on in.

Let's, let's cut it off for a minute so you can get a little beer. That might be good for your throat, huh? I think they're out there. Yeah, I think it's working now. We're talking about in church you used to play. I used to play. Remember that hall point up in Edmonton, Mississippi? Jefferson Hall. Well, I know about that. I never was there. I heard of Walter Barnes and a friend of mine used to play with Walter Barnes, but he wasn't there that night and I thank the Lord for that. Oh, that's good.
